purpose: Deliver the README task with independent design and test evidence, then verified implementation.

coordinator.name: implementing-lead
coordinator.purpose: Own all implementation edits, consult the verification group, run tests, collect every collaborator result and reconcile relevant findings before final response.
coordinator.deliverable: Working implementation files in the root workspace, independently checked against README, with every participant outcome reconciled.
acceptance: Public tests remain unchanged; run relevant executable checks and name their results.
Collect the verification coordinator result and address concrete counterexamples before finalizing.
Distinguish observed checks, proposed checks, failed peers and unverified assumptions.

swarms.purpose: Find specification edge cases and concrete verification guidance without changing implementation files.

coordinator.name: verification-coordinator
coordinator.purpose: Synthesize the retained results of both independent reviewers. Use direct peer evidence and challenge material disagreements. Send one actionable synthesis upward to the root lead with swarm_message. Do not edit files or wait for already-completed peers to reply.
coordinator.deliverable: A compact synthesis of specification risks, concrete test cases, disagreements, and which root checks are still needed.
acceptance: Reference both direct predecessor results; do not repeat their full transcripts.
Separate observed implementation defects from hypotheses and unrun checks.
Send the root a typed handoff and finish; do not wait on your own completion.

agents.name: specification-reviewer
agents.purpose: Read README and current implementation. Identify the three highest-risk correctness requirements and examples. Send concise evidence directly to your group coordinator, optionally discuss disagreements with the testing peer, then finish. Do not edit files.
agents.deliverable: A concise independent contribution with at most three high-value findings, supporting evidence and a concrete next check.
acceptance: Read README and relevant implementation; identify concrete examples, not generic advice.
Use swarm_message to send findings to verification-coordinator; its dependency-delayed start does not require you to wait.
Send needed execution requests to implementing-lead; do not execute tests in a read-only workspace.
Finish with the same evidence summary so the durable handoff is usable without another model turn.

agents.name: testing-reviewer
agents.purpose: Read README and current implementation. Derive focused edge-case and failure tests. Send concise concrete cases directly to your group coordinator, optionally discuss disagreements with the specification peer, then finish. Do not edit files.
agents.deliverable: A concise independent contribution with at most three high-value findings, supporting evidence and a concrete next check.
acceptance: Read README and relevant implementation; identify concrete examples, not generic advice.
Use swarm_message to send findings to verification-coordinator; its dependency-delayed start does not require you to wait.
Send needed execution requests to implementing-lead; do not execute tests in a read-only workspace.
Finish with the same evidence summary so the durable handoff is usable without another model turn.
